original.target_description: Table 2, column (3), all-country country-year regression of early-stage entrepreneurship paying wages on median age (ages 20-64), with year dummies and country-clustered standard errors; GEM 2001-2010. Target identified by supplied replication report. Original text is the November 2016 revised NBER working-paper version of the supplied JPE article, with matching title, authors, table and coefficient.

n.location: Printed p. 56, Table 2, column (3), Obs row
n.sample_role: Analytic country-year observations; weighted by individuals per country-year cell.
n.exclusions: Specific exclusions not established; all-country specification.

es.location: Printed p. 56, Table 2, column (3), Median age (age 20-64) row

p.location: Printed p. 56, Table 2, column (3), median-age significance marker and table note

replication.target_description: SCORE report by Nathan Fiala and Victor Volkman for Liang et al. (2018), target Table 2 column (3); country-year entrepreneurship rate regressed on country median age. Selected independent replication estimate uses newly added 2011-2016 data, rather than pooled original-plus-new observations.

n.location: PDF p. 2, Replication Result, sample paragraph
n.quote: The sample for the new data included 391 observations
n.sample_role: New-data observations (2011-2016), country-year regression; report labels these observations.
n.exclusions: Not documented in report; analytic status inferred from the sample statement immediately following new-data regression results.

es.location: PDF p. 2, Replication Result, new-data estimate
es.quote:
The relationship in the new data (2011 to 2016) is -0.0079 (p-value 0.0000,
CI: [-0.010, -0.0055]).

p.location: PDF p. 2, Replication Result, new-data estimate
p.quote:
The relationship in the new data (2011 to 2016) is -0.0079 (p-value 0.0000,
CI: [-0.010, -0.0055]).

reported_success.location: PDF p. 2, Replication Result, opening sentence
reported_success.quote: We find that the results are robust to the inclusion of the additional years of data.

notes: Input has no neutral description or test locator. Supplied OSF file explicitly identifies Table 2 column (3), allowing target identification. Original source acquired from NBER is revised November 2016, not the published JPE PDF; same title/authors and target table match the replication report. Original p is the printed 1% significance threshold, not an exact computed p. Replication p is retained as printed (rounded 0.0000), not interpreted as a mathematically exact zero. Replication report additionally gives original-data reanalysis coefficient -0.0074 and pooled 2001-2016 coefficient -0.0077 (both printed p-value 0.0000); neither is merged with the new-data n. Requested replication es_type ser_method does not name a printed effect metric, so the printed regression coefficient is retained.
